parameters.text:
👋 Welcome to UniPlan – your class timetable assistant!

Commands:
/add Code | Description | Day | Start | End | Room | Teacher | Credits – add a class (Room, Teacher, Credits optional)
/import – send a timetable screenshot with /import as caption to add classes automatically
/edit ClassID | Field | NewValue – change a class
/drop ClassID – remove a class
/schedule – show your full timetable
/today, /tomorrow, /day Monday – show one day
/next – show your next class
/help – syntax and examples

Quick start:
/add COMM 355 | Private Equity | Tuesday | 08:30 | 10:00

📖 UniPlan help

/add Code | Description | Day | Start | End | Room | Teacher | Credits
  ✦ ex: /add COMM 355 | Private Equity | Tuesday | 08:30 | 10:00 | GOODES RM153 | Libitz, Greg | 3

  • Required: a code or description, Day, Start, End
  • Optional: Room, Teacher, Credits, leave them off, leave empty, or write TBD
  ✦ ex: /add COMM 355 | Private Equity | Tue | 8:30AM | 10:00AM | | | 3

Time format:
   ✦ Day: Mon–Sun. 
   ✦ Times: 24-hour (14:30) or 8:30AM. End must be later than start. No overlaps.

/edit ClassID | Field | NewValue
  Fields: code, description, day, start, end, room, teacher, credits
     ✦  Ex: /edit C1A2B3CDE | room | B305
  Use - to clear an optional field: /edit C1A2B3CDE | teacher | -

/drop ClassID
  ✦ Ex: /drop C1A2B3CDE
  • Get IDs from /schedule

/schedule – your timetable sorted by day and time

/today – today's classes
/tomorrow – tomorrow's classes
/day Monday – classes on a given day (Mon–Sun)
/next – your next upcoming class

/import (as the caption of a screenshot)
  Reads the classes from a screenshot of your course page and adds one entry per meeting.
  • The image is read by an AI model, fix with /edit or /drop

/start – welcome message
/help – this message

parameters.content:
## UniPlan main workflow
1. Select your Telegram credential on every Telegram node.
2. Select your Google Sheets credential and set the spreadsheet ID on 'Log Rejected Command'.
3. In 'Run Timetable Operation' pick the imported UniPlan - Timetable Operations sub-workflow.
4. /import: select your OpenAI credential on 'Call Vision Model' and set `MODEL` in 'Prepare Vision Request'.
5. Activate the workflow (HTTPS webhook URL required for Telegram).
